subject: website
name: LocalSafe
summary: LocalSafe, a client-side Safe account interface by Cyfrin with no backend, open source (MIT) in Cyfrin/localsafe.eth. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens its bundled wallet kit fetches configuration from api.web3modal.org and reports to pulse.walletconnect.org before any wallet is connected.

connections.name: WalletConnect and Reown (api.web3modal.org, pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Configuration and telemetry requests from the site's own bundled wallet kit when the page opens, before a wallet is connected.
